unit.why: A short memorate: a famed sage lodged with the narrator's in-laws on his way back from visiting the Chortkov rebbe and said he had found a true rebbe in him.

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי חותני הרב הצדיק שליט״א
stories.summary_en: The narrator's father- and mother-in-law tell how a renowned sage lodged with them in Zablotow on his way back from the Chortkov rebbe. He said that after his own masters died he had feared he would find no rebbe, but in R. David Moshe he had found a rebbe in the full sense.
